exposure_proportionality.value: The paper states plasma exposure was dose-proportional between its lowest and highest levels; its printed table, with N per cohort 1, 1, 3, 3, 3, 8, 5 across seven levels and printed CVs of 4.1 to 79 percent (only for cohorts of three or more), gives day 5 exposure (AUC) roughly proportional to dose from the second to the sixth cohort (log-log slope about 0.95 by the two end points, about 0.98 over the five points, a span that still begins at a cohort of one), supralinear only when the lowest cohort, a single patient, is included (slope about 1.38), and 1.27-fold higher at the top cohort than at the one below for a 2.0-fold dose ratio; the day 1 exposure cell of the top cohort is blank.
